about: Virginia locality data for Footing: rents, crime, shelter beds, local rules and shapes for all 95 counties and 38 independent cities. Built by scripts/build_va_localities.py from captures in fixtures/va_2026-10-24.

crime.title: FBI Crime Data Explorer, offenses known to law enforcement, by agency
crime.note: FBI 'violent crime' = murder, rape, robbery, aggravated assault. Agencies' own populations; county sheriffs cover areas outside towns that have their own police.

incidents.title: City police incident feeds (Norfolk, Charlottesville)
incidents.note: Offense labels sorted by footing/static/va_offense_classes.json; geocoded by block with the Census batch geocoder; counted per 0.01-degree tile. No address or incident ID is kept.

shelter.title: HUD 2025 Housing Inventory Count by CoC

coc_map.title: HUD Continuum of Care Grantee Areas

rules.title: Footing local rules table (cited per row)

violent_per_100k.rule: 10th and 90th percentile of Virginia localities with data

tile_violent_3x3.rule: violent incidents in the 3x3 tiles around a point (about 3 km across), 12 months; bad = 90th percentile of recorded tiles

rules_note.text: Virginia has no statewide camping ban, and a 2026 bill to stop local bans (HB1394) was continued to 2027.
rules_note.source_title: WHRO, 'Virginia House committee kills bill to decriminalize homelessness', 2026-02-08

rule_statuses.ban_citywide: Camping or sleeping on public property is a crime across the locality. Scored 0.
rule_statuses.ban_partial: Banned in part of the locality (for example downtown sidewalks or public rights-of-way). Scored 35.
rule_statuses.proposed_not_adopted: A ban was proposed and not adopted. Not scored: other rules can still be used to move people.
rule_statuses.checked_none_found: Searched; no camping or sleeping ordinance found. Not scored.
